_metadata.description: Post-launch requirements. Each mirrors one P1 operational target one-to-one and carries at least two automated validation layers.

requirements.description: Given reachable access to an existing host, the scenario should enroll it as a node without creating or billing anything
requirements.title: Adopt a machine the operator already owns

validation.notes: Intended: api/internal/enroll/adopt_test.go [REQ tag required]. Adopting an existing host records no instance, no intent and no reservation, so a machine the operator already owns is never metered.
Intended: api/internal/enroll/adopt_integration_test.go [REQ tag required]. An adopted host reaches the online state through the same bridge onboarding contract as a provisioned one.

requirements.description: The scenario should refuse a request that would take a tenant past its ceiling, rather than rely on a provider spend alert that only sends mail
requirements.title: Per-tenant ceiling computed from our own meter

validation.notes: Intended: api/internal/meter/ceiling_test.go [REQ tag required]. A request that would take a tenant past its computed ceiling is refused with the ceiling named, rather than accepted and alarmed afterwards.
Intended: api/internal/meter/ceiling_integration_test.go [REQ tag required]. Concurrent requests against one tenant cannot jointly exceed the ceiling.

requirements.description: The scenario should compare metered usage against the provider's own billing daily and raise an alarm when they diverge beyond a threshold
requirements.title: Daily cost reconciliation against the provider

validation.notes: Intended: api/internal/reconcile/cost_test.go [REQ tag required]. Metered usage and a provider statement that diverge beyond the threshold produce an alarm; divergence inside the threshold produces a record and no alarm.
Intended: api/internal/reconcile/cost_integration_test.go [REQ tag required]. A daily comparison runs against the fake provider's billing surface and never feeds its result back into a charge.

requirements.description: The scenario should support a second provider behind the same interface with no change to any consumer
requirements.title: A second provider changes no caller

validation.notes: Intended: api/internal/provider/registry_test.go [REQ tag required]. Two registered providers are selected by identifier alone, and each declares its own rounding, minimum billable unit and stopped-instance billing behaviour as data.
Intended: api/internal/provider/caller_independence_test.go [REQ tag required]. An AST assertion that no domain or handler package references a provider by name.

requirements.description: The scenario should render live inventory, elapsed cost and remaining lifetime for every instance it owns
requirements.title: Operator inventory surface

validation.notes: Intended: ui/src/features/inventory/__tests__/InventoryTable.test.tsx [REQ tag required]. The table renders loading, empty, populated, expiring-soon and unaccounted states, and distinguishes each without relying on colour alone.

Intended: ui/src/features/inventory/__tests__/inventory.integration.test.tsx [REQ tag required]. Live inventory, elapsed cost and remaining lifetime render from the generated client against a stubbed API, with figures in tabular numerals.
